newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-KNICKS SIGN FIRST-ROUND PICK THOMAS.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-KNICKS SIGN FIRST-ROUND PICK THOMAS.

text.p: The New York Knicks on Thursday signed University of Minnesota forward John Thomas, the team's first-round pick and 25th overall selection in the June draft.

The Knicks did not officially disclose terms, but under the league's collective bargaining provisions, the 25th pick is slotted to make $1.841 million over three seasons. Teams, however, are allowed to offer 20 percent above that which could push the deal to about $2.2 million for Thomas.
Thomas helped lead Minnesota to its first-ever trip to the Final Four in 1997. He averaged 9.0 points and 6.3 rebounds and shot 57.6 percent from the floor in 35 games.
"John is an extremely hard worker who should fit in very well with our team," said Knicks president and general manager Ernie Grunfeld. "He's a rugged player and is sound defensively."
